lines.text: Hi! I'm Daxter, the brightest lightbulb on the Road of Wonders! <break time="0.6s" /> And you? You're the explorer I've been waiting for. <break time="0.6s" /> My goal is simple: to turn your screen time into brain time. <break time="0.8s" /> Did you know that nobody… not your parents, not your teachers, not even superheroes… can stop kids from scrolling? <break time="0.8s" /> So I had a crazy idea. What if we didn't stop you… what if we made your scrolling smart? <break time="0.7s" /> And here's a secret, just for you: somewhere in this video, a glowing card will show you a magic word. Watch for it, and remember it! It's a bonus: type it in the game, and a secret surprise opens up. <break time="0.5s" /> Ready, explorer? Let's go!

Level one! Climb the Screen-Time Tower with me! <break time="0.5s" /> Scientists in America asked thousands of families how long kids like you spend on screens, just for fun. <break time="0.7s" /> Floor one: ages two to four. About two and a half hours a day! <break time="0.7s" /> Floor two: ages five to eight. More than three hours! <break time="0.7s" /> Floor three: ages eight to twelve. Hold on tight… five and a half hours. Every. Single. Day. <break time="0.7s" /> And the top floor, teenagers? Almost nine hours! That's longer than a whole school day! <break time="0.6s" /> Hmm… which floor are you on?

So where do all those hours go? Come on, I'll show you. <break time="0.5s" /> This is Endless Video Land… where videos and games start the next one automatically. Did you notice? There's never a moment to stop! <break time="0.7s" /> That's not an accident. It's a trick… and I know who's behind it. <break time="0.5s" /> The Scroll Monster! <break time="0.8s" /> Wait… look! The glowing card is coming. Remember the magic word!

Did you remember the magic word? <break time="0.4s" /> Sun! Like the big, bright sun in the sky. <break time="0.6s" /> Now… boss fight! Stay close to me, explorer. <break time="0.4s" /> The Scroll Monster is sneaky. He steals dinner… “just one more video”. <break time="0.6s" /> He steals sleep. You need nine to twelve hours every night, and screens at bedtime keep your brain buzzing. <break time="0.6s" /> And he steals friends. Real ones, the kind you play football with! <break time="0.7s" /> Doctors and the World Health Organization say little kids, aged two to five, should have no more than one hour of screens a day. <break time="0.5s" /> But you and me? We're smarter than him. Yoink! We win the treasures back!

Look who's here! Professor Hoot, my wise owl friend, with a glowing map: the Road of Wonders! <break time="0.6s" /> So here's my deal for you. In Did You Know That, you still scroll… but every story teaches you something real. <break time="0.6s" /> Read the magic book, watch the story, answer Professor Hoot, and win Special Cards. Collect them, earn points, and climb the leaderboard! <break time="0.7s" /> And the best part? The game lets you watch only three videos a day. Then I'll tell you: go eat, go sleep, go play with your friends. I'll wait for you tomorrow. Promise!

Level one complete! High five, explorer! <break time="0.5s" /> Now listen carefully, here's how to win your card. <break time="0.5s" /> Step one: ask a grown-up to open dexty dot live. Pick Kids, and press Start the adventure. <break time="0.6s" /> Step two: walk me along the road with the arrow buttons, to the first house… the one that says Episode One. Tap the house to go inside. <break time="0.6s" /> Step three is a bonus! In the magic book, find the wax seal and type the magic word… <break time="0.3s" /> SUN! <break time="0.4s" /> Then press Break seal for a surprise. <break time="0.6s" /> Step four: answer Professor Hoot's three questions, and the Scroll Tamer card is yours! <break time="0.6s" /> Step five: tap the backpack at the top of the screen. That's your collection! Every card you win stays there, and you can watch its video again anytime. <break time="0.6s" /> Did you know that? Now you do. See you on the Road of Wonders. Bye for now!
